name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with mandatory product routing, modular specialist routing, audit, design systems, accessibility, performance, and RTL/LTR workflows.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production product interfaces with mandatory product-type routing. Supports dashboards, web applications, mobile applications, and WordPress plugin settings/admin UI, with product-specific required packs plus modular specialist routing for Persian-facing UI and runtime browser validation. Includes evidence-driven UX audits, visual regression, design-system architecture, responsive behavior, Light/Dark themes, RTL/LTR, personalization, Data Trust UX, accessibility, performance, and regression-aware QA.
capabilities: Route UI work by product type before design
Design dashboards and operational data UI
Design WordPress plugin settings and admin UI
Route Persian-facing UI to required language QA
defaultPrompt: Classify this product, load the required Product Pack, then audit and improve its UI/UX without breaking behavior.
Design this web or mobile application using the correct product-specific UI/UX rules and validate representative states.
Improve this WordPress plugin settings UI using the WordPress product route while preserving permissions and behavior.
